text: minervini: "Inverted 50/200 and RS rank 32.12." Agreed on the higher timeframe (C16). With ma_50 110.23 under ma_200 118.51 this is markup leaving a lower range, not an established trend, and my conviction is 2 for that reason. I do not oppose a fresh break that is holding. I support only a held test of the Creek (structure_shift_ref) followed by a sign-of-strength bar, because the break bar itself was not one. A daily close under structure_shift_ref is a failed breakout and ends it. A wide high close on volume above the Creek is the one observable that would raise my conviction.
